top=()=>window.scrollTo(0,0);const pick=(sel,text)=>{const o=[...sel.options].find(x=>x.text.trim()===text||x.text.includes(text));if(!o)throw new Error('no option '+text);set(sel,o.value);};const row=(e)=>e.closest('.setting')||e.closest('li')||e.closest('label')||e;await until(()=>document.querySelector('input[name=copies-kind][value=rclone]')); const r=document.querySelector('input[name=copies-kind][value=rclone]'); r.click(); await wait(800); tag(r.closest('label'),'c');
